xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3341: Pipeline board shows stale phase (e.g. Planning) for issues that are Done and merged but never close-ceremonied

plan.title: Pipeline board shows stale phase (e.g. Planning) for issues that are Done and merged but never close-ceremonied
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: The dashboard derives an issue's displayed phase from the tracker-row cache and local resource artifacts. When the tracker row ages out of the issue-service sync window, deriveStateLabel (src/dashboard/server/services/resource-discovery.ts:205-219) falls through to artifact heuristics — hasPrd → 'Planning', workspace/branch → 'Allocated' — and getPipelineIssuePhase (src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/pipeline-state.ts:127) deliberately ignores the canonical pipeline-membership verdict (a contract locked by pipeline-state.test.ts:38-53 and PipelineView.test.tsx:135-150). Result: an issue merged to main and tracker-Done renders as 'Planning' (observed MIN-852/861/882 on the MYN Command Deck, 2026-07-30), telling the operator the exact opposite of reality.
narratives.Proposal: Reconcile the displayed phase against the canonical resolvePipelineMembership verdict (tracker + forge + git lenses, already snapshotted and attached to both feeds) at the two derivation points: (1) deriveStateLabel gains a membership parameter — post_merge_limbo → 'Merged — Needs Close-Out', clean_terminal with L3_issueOpen === false → 'Done'/'Closed', checked before readyForMerge; (2) getPipelineIssuePhase returns 'ship' for available post_merge_limbo membership, and the two tests locking the old contract are rewritten to the narrowed contract; (3) useIssueActions.isMerged (useIssueActions.ts:330) also accepts the post_merge_limbo bucket so the existing closeOut registry action (POST /api/issues/:id/close-out) becomes enabled and phase-primary (MERGED) on limbo rows; (4) FeatureItem/ProjectOverview map the new label to the warning tone and the ship bucket; (5) docs/PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md documents the reconciliation contract. No new lane, button, endpoint, or gather machinery.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing zombie_pr (closed issue, open PR) rendering or adding a zombie-specific label
- Changing the resource-discovery tree inclusion filter (resource-discovery.ts:737-744) — tracker-Done merged issues with no live resources correctly drop out of the tree
- Adding a new pipeline lane/glyph/URL filter for limbo — the ship lane plus row label carries it
- Speeding up or restructuring the 5-minute membership snapshot refresh cadence
- Reconciling the WorkspaceStatusCard memory-synthesized phase (exploring/planning/building…) — a different phase vocabulary, not the observed defect
- Auto-running pan close — the affordance enables the existing operator-initiated closeOut action only

autoDecisions.summary: Fix at the two existing read-door derivation points (server deriveStateLabel, frontend getPipelineIssuePhase) keyed on the canonical membership verdict already attached to both feeds, instead of introducing a new derived-phase field or new gather machinery.
autoDecisions.rationale: The membership snapshot is the single source of truth the issue asks the board to defer to; it is already computed every 5 minutes from tracker + forge + git and already reaches both surfaces (pipelineBucket on resource-allocated rows, pipelineMembership on /api/issues DTOs). The defect is that consumers ignore it, not that evidence is missing.

autoDecisions.summary: post_merge_limbo maps to the existing 'ship' lane rather than a new 'needs close-out' lane.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body explicitly allows 'done (or explicitly merged — needs close-out)'. A new lane costs glyphs, URL filter params, and PhaseHeader styles for no extra information; the 'Merged — Needs Close-Out' row label plus the close-out action carry the ceremony signal.

autoDecisions.summary: Close-out affordance is delivered by extending useIssueActions.isMerged with the membership bucket, reusing the existing closeOut registry action.
autoDecisions.rationale: The registry (issueActions.ts) is the single action source; isMerged=true both satisfies canCloseOut and routes deriveIssueActionPhase to MERGED, making Close out phase-primary in the existing context menu. No new UI surface to keep in parity.

autoDecisions.summary: Membership checks are placed at the top of deriveStateLabel, before the readyForMerge check, and clean_terminal only maps to Done/Closed when lenses.L3_issueOpen === false.
autoDecisions.rationale: A stale readyForMerge flag must not outrank a merged PR, and clean_terminal also covers open-never-started backlog (pipeline-membership.ts:173), which must never render as Done.

autoDecisions.summary: When membership is unavailable for an issue, rendering falls through to today's artifact heuristics.
autoDecisions.rationale: unavailablePipelineMembership() reports a sentinel bucket of clean_terminal; guessing merged/done without the canonical verdict would reintroduce the same class of lie in the opposite direction.

items.title: Make deriveStateLabel membership-aware: post_merge_limbo → 'Merged — Needs Close-Out', tracker-closed → Done/Closed

expected_outputs: resource-discovery test suite passes including the six new membership-reconciliation cases

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/services/resource-discovery.ts, add an optional `membership?: PipelineMembership` parameter to deriveStateLabel (line 205) and pass the already-in-scope `membership` at the single call site (line 749). Insert two checks at the TOP of the function, before the readyForMerge check: (1) `if (membership?.bucket === 'post_merge_limbo') return 'Merged — Needs Close-Out';` (2) `if (membership?.bucket === 'clean_terminal' && membership.lenses.L3_issueOpen === false) return hasTmux ? 'Closed' : 'Done';`. The L3 guard is mandatory — clean_terminal also covers open-never-started backlog, which must keep its current label. No new gather work: the memberships map is already populated at lines 700-707. Extend tests/unit/dashboard/server/services/resource-discovery.test.ts with cases: (a) post_merge_limbo + hasPrd → 'Merged — Needs Close-Out'; (b) post_merge_limbo outranks readyForMerge; (c) clean_terminal + L3_issueOpen false + no tmux → 'Done'; (d) same + tmux → 'Closed'; (e) clean_terminal + L3_issueOpen true → NOT 'Done'; (f) no membership → unchanged heuristics. Follow the existing refreshResourceAllocatedProjects fixture pattern (test lines 186-225) for feeding membership verdicts.

items.title: Given an issue with membership bucket post_merge_limbo and a stale PRD artifact, when GET /api/issues/resource-allocated is served, then the row's stateLabel renders 'Merged — Needs Close-Out' and never 'Planning' or 'Allocated'

Given an issue with membership bucket post_merge_limbo and readyForMerge true, when deriveStateLabel runs, then it returns 'Merged — Needs Close-Out' (the merged-PR verdict outranks the stale ready flag)

Given an issue with membership bucket clean_terminal and lenses.L3_issueOpen === false, when deriveStateLabel runs, then it returns 'Done' (no tmux) or 'Closed' (tmux present); given L3_issueOpen === true it preserves the current non-Done label
Given an issue with no membership verdict, when deriveStateLabel runs, then it falls through to the existing artifact heuristics unchanged (hasPrd → 'Planning')
npx vitest run tests/unit/dashboard/server/services/resource-discovery.test.ts exits 0 with the six new cases green and npm run typecheck completes without errors
Render 'Merged — Needs Close-Out' correctly in the Command Deck tree and ProjectOverview pipeline section

expected_outputs: FeatureItem and ProjectOverview suites pass with the new label cases green

narrative.Action: The label string is pinned by membership-aware-state-label as 'Merged — Needs Close-Out'; frontend matchers MUST use lowercase includes('close-out') rather than equality on the em-dash form. (1) getFeatureStateTone (FeatureItem.tsx:515-523): map the new label to the existing 'review' tone (the warning/needs-attention signal per the dashboard style guide's color-equals-signal rule) so it never falls through to 'todo' or reads as 'planning'. (2) featureState() (ProjectOverview.tsx:64-72): add `if (raw.includes('close-out')) return 'done';` so bucketFeaturePhase lands the row in the ship lane via the existing terminal-state path in getPipelineIssuePhase. (3) Tests: tone mapping for the new label; a feature with stateLabel 'Merged — Needs Close-Out' buckets 'ship', not 'plan'.

items.title: Given a feature whose stateLabel is 'Merged — Needs Close-Out', when getFeatureStateTone runs, then it returns the 'review' tone and never the 'planning' tone or the default fallthrough tone
Given a feature whose stateLabel is 'Merged — Needs Close-Out', when bucketFeaturePhase runs, then it returns 'ship' (not 'plan')
npx vitest run on the FeatureItem and ProjectOverview suites exits 0 with the new cases green and npm run typecheck completes without errors
getPipelineIssuePhase returns 'ship' for available post_merge_limbo membership; rewrite the two tests locking the old contract

expected_outputs: pipeline-state and PipelineView suites pass with the narrowed membership contract

narrative.Action: In getPipelineIssuePhase (src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/pipeline-state.ts:127), after the terminal-state check (lines 133-135) and before the mergeStatus block, add: `if (issue.pipelineMembership?.available === true && issue.pipelineMembership.bucket === 'post_merge_limbo') { return 'ship'; }` with a PAN-3341 comment noting the canonical verdict outranks a stale stored phase. The available === true guard is mandatory — unavailablePipelineMembership() reports a sentinel bucket of clean_terminal. Then rewrite the two tests that lock the old contract (do NOT delete them): (1) pipeline-state.test.ts:38-53 'does not use server membership as a lane-assignment signal' → narrowed contract: post_merge_limbo backlog issue → 'ship'; clean_terminal on a ready-labeled issue → still 'ready'; unavailable membership → unchanged; rename the test to state the exception. (2) PipelineView.test.tsx:135-150 'keeps phase derivation unchanged when server membership is attached' → the post_merge_limbo + state 'in_review' issue now renders in the SHIP lane; rename accordingly.

items.title: Given an issue with available membership bucket post_merge_limbo and stored state 'in_review' (or 'in_progress', or hasPlan true), when getPipelineIssuePhase runs, then it returns 'ship'

Given an issue with membership bucket clean_terminal (or in_flight, or unavailable membership), when getPipelineIssuePhase runs, then lane assignment is identical to the same issue without membership attached
PipelineView renders a post_merge_limbo issue in the ship lane section (updated integration assertion replaces the old review-lane assertion)
npx vitest run on the pipeline-state and PipelineView suites exits 0 and npm run typecheck completes without errors
Enable the existing Close out action on post_merge_limbo rows via useIssueActions.isMerged

expected_outputs: IssueActionMenu suites pass with the new limbo case green

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/IssueActionMenu/useIssueActions.ts line 330, extend the isMerged derivation to also accept the canonical membership bucket: `isMerged: reviewStatus?.mergeStatus === 'merged' || issue?.mergeStatus === 'merged' || issue?.pipelineMembership?.bucket === 'post_merge_limbo',`. This satisfies canCloseOut (issueActions.ts:563-566) and routes derivePipelineState to 'merged' → deriveIssueActionPhase MERGED (issuePipelineState.ts:48-55, issueActions.ts:660-710), making the existing closeOut registry action (POST /api/issues/:id/close-out) enabled and phase-primary in the row context menu. No new button, endpoint, or dialog. Test: a store issue with pipelineMembership { available: true, inPipeline: true, bucket: 'post_merge_limbo', labelDrift: null }, stale state 'in_progress', and no review-status merge evidence yields the closeOut action enabled and derived phase MERGED.

items.title: Given a store issue with pipelineMembership bucket post_merge_limbo, stale state 'in_progress', and no review-status merge evidence, when useIssueActions builds state, then isMerged is true and the closeOut action is enabled
Given the same limbo issue, when deriveIssueActionPhase runs, then it returns MERGED so Close out appears as the phase-primary action

narrative.Action: Add a 'Surface reconciliation (PAN-3341)' section to docs/PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md stating: the resource-discovery stateLabel and the frontend lane classifier (getPipelineIssuePhase) both defer to the canonical membership verdict; 'Merged — Needs Close-Out' is the post_merge_limbo display label; post_merge_limbo is the only bucket that overrides a stored phase (mapping to the ship lane); clean_terminal with L3_issueOpen === false renders Done/Closed; unavailable membership never changes rendering; the Close out action enables on limbo rows via the isMerged derivation. Then sweep configuration/ and reference/ (Mintlify) for any page enumerating tree stateLabel values — add the new label if one exists, otherwise state the negative finding in the commit message.

items.title: docs/PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md contains a 'Surface reconciliation (PAN-3341)' section naming the 'Merged — Needs Close-Out' label, the ship-lane mapping, the L3_issueOpen guard, and the unavailable-membership fallback
